title: DRIFTLENS: Measuring Memory-Induced Reasoning Drift in Personalized Language Models
reasoning: The paper curates a benchmark of unverifiable questions, drawing from domains such as ethics and daily dilemmas (e.g., using the ETHICS and DailyDilemmas datasets), and defines a value ontology to evaluate how LLM reasoning trajectories shift across moral, ethical, and social values when injected with different user personas.
